source.text: ה֣וֹי רֹעִ֗ים מְאַבְּדִ֧ים וּמְפִצִ֛ים אֶת־צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתִ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe [to] shepherds destroying and scattering [the] flock of my pasture, declares Yahweh.

en.L: Woe, shepherds who destroy and scatter the flock of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} pasture, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Woe to the shepherds who are destroying and scattering the sheep of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} pasture, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: How terrible it will be for the shepherds who are destroying {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} flock and scattering the sheep I feed in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own pasture, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: ¡Ay de los pastores que destruyen y dispersan el rebaño de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pasto!, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: ¡Ay de los pastores que están destruyendo y dispersando las ovejas de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pasto!, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para los pastores que están destruyendo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rebaño y dispersando las ovejas que yo alimento en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} propios pastos!, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Malheur, bergers qui font périr et qui dispersent le troupeau de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} pâturage, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Malheur aux bergers qui font périr et dispersent les brebis de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} pâturage, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour les bergers qui font périr {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} troupeau et dispersent les brebis que je nourris dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} propre pâturage ! dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Ole, wachungaji wanaoharibu na kutawanya kondoo wa malisho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ole wao wachungaji wanaowaangamiza na kuwatawanya kondoo wa malisho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa wachungaji wanaoliangamiza kundi {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na kuwatawanya kondoo ninaowalisha katika malisho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} mwenyewe, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Khốn cho những người chăn hủy hoại và làm tan lạc bầy chiên của đồng cỏ Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Khốn cho những người chăn đang hủy hoại và làm tan tác đàn chiên trong đồng cỏ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho những người chăn đang hủy hoại bầy chiên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và làm tan lạc đàn chiên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nuôi trong đồng cỏ của chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 내 목장의 양 떼를 멸망시키고 흩어 버리는 목자들에게 화가 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 내 목장의 양들을 죽게 하고 흩어 버리는 목자들에게 화가 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 내 양 떼를 망치고, 내가 내 목장에서 먹이는 양들을 흩어 버리는 목자들에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Ai dos pastores que destroem e dispersam o rebanho da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} pastagem, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Ai dos pastores que estão destruindo e dispersando as ovelhas da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} pastagem, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Que desgraça vai cair sobre os pastores que estão destruindo o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rebanho e espalhando as ovelhas que eu alimento na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} própria pastagem, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: shepherds: the kings and rulers of Judah
decisions.reason: Kings in the ancient Near East were called the shepherds of their people, and Jeremiah uses the word for Judah's rulers (2:8; 10:21; 22:22). Coming straight after the oracles on the last kings of Judah in chapter 22, this woe is aimed at them.

decisions.choice: destroy: let the flock perish
decisions.reason: The verb means to destroy or to let perish. Said of sheep it can also mean letting them stray and be lost (50:6, "lost sheep"). Either way the rulers' neglect is ruining the flock.

decisions.choice: the flock of my pasture: the people belong to God, not to the shepherds
decisions.reason: God calls the people "my" flock, grazing in "my" pasture (Psalm 100:3; Ezekiel 34:31). The rulers only look after what is his, and he will call them to account for it (verse 2).

decisions.choice: Woe (Literal); Woe to (Balanced); How terrible it will be for (Readable)
decisions.reason: The book's wording for the cry of woe, as in Isaiah. Readable spells out the threat in plain words.

decisions.choice: Ole, ... (Literal); Ole wao ... (Balanced); Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa ... (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for *hoy* as a threat; Balanced takes "wao" because the shepherds are many.

decisions.choice: "Malheur, bergers" (L); "Malheur aux bergers" (B); "Quel malheur pour les bergers ... !" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of hoy set for Jeremiah 18-34 (as 22:13).

decisions.choice: "người chăn" (shepherds) at every level here
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 build a picture on the word "shepherd", so every level keeps it; meaning decision m1 says that the kings and rulers are meant.

source.text: לָ֠כֵן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַֽל־הָרֹעִים֮ הָרֹעִ֣ים אֶת־עַמִּי֒ אַתֶּ֞ם הֲפִצֹתֶ֤ם אֶת־צֹאנִי֙ וַתַּדִּח֔וּם וְלֹ֥א פְקַדְתֶּ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם הִנְנִ֨י פֹקֵ֧ד עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אֶת־רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh [the] God of Israel concerning the shepherds shepherding my people: you have scattered my flock and driven them away and not attended to them; look, I [am] attending to you [for the] evil of your deeds, declares Yahweh.

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, concerning the shepherds who shepherd {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people: You have scattered {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} flock and driven them away, and you have not attended to them; look, I am about to attend to you [for] the evil of your deeds, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says this about the shepherds who shepherd {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people: You have scattered {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} flock and chased them off, and you have not looked after them. So now I will look after you, and punish the evil you have done, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says to the shepherds who take care of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people: You have scattered {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} flock and chased them away. You did not take care of them. So now I will take care of you: I will punish you for the evil things you have done, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, acerca de los pastores que apacientan a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo: {{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} dispersado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rebaño y lo {{plural_you:han|habéis}} ahuyentado, y no lo {{plural_you:han|habéis}} atendido; he aquí, yo voy a {{plural_you:atenderlos|atenderos}} [por] la maldad de {{plural_you:sus obras|vuestras obras}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, dice esto acerca de los pastores que apacientan a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo: {{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} dispersado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rebaño y lo {{plural_you:han|habéis}} espantado, y no lo {{plural_you:han|habéis}} cuidado. Ahora yo me ocuparé de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y castigaré el mal que {{plural_you:han|habéis}} hecho, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, a los pastores que cuidan de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo: {{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} dispersado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rebaño y lo {{plural_you:han|habéis}} ahuyentado. No lo {{plural_you:cuidaron|cuidasteis}}. Así que ahora yo me ocuparé de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré por las maldades que {{plural_you:han|habéis}} hecho, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, au sujet des bergers qui font paître {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple : Vous avez dispersé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} troupeau, vous les avez chassées, et vous ne vous êtes pas occupés d’elles ; voici, je vais m’occuper de vous [pour] la méchanceté de vos actions, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci au sujet des bergers qui font paître {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple : Vous avez dispersé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} troupeau, vous l’avez chassé, et vous ne vous en êtes pas occupés. Eh bien, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je vais m’occuper de vous et punir le mal que vous avez fait, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, aux bergers qui prennent soin de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple : Vous avez dispersé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} troupeau et vous l’avez chassé. Vous n’en avez pas pris soin. Alors maintenant, c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui vais m’occuper de vous : je vais vous punir pour le mal que vous avez fait, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi kuhusu wachungaji wanaowachunga watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}: Ninyi mmewatawanya kondoo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na kuwafukuza, wala hamkuwaangalia; tazama, nitawaangalia ninyi [kwa] uovu wa matendo yenu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo kuhusu wachungaji wanaowachunga watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}: Mmelitawanya kundi {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na kuwafukuza, wala hamkuwatunza. Basi sasa nitawashughulikia ninyi, nami nitawaadhibu kwa uovu mliotenda, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema kwa wachungaji wanaowatunza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}: Mmelitawanya kundi {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na kuwafukuza. Hamkuwatunza. Basi sasa nitawashughulikia ninyi: nitawaadhibu kwa maovu mliyoyatenda, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này về những người chăn chăn dắt dân Ta: Các ngươi đã làm tan lạc bầy chiên Ta, xua đuổi chúng, và không chăm sóc chúng; kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chăm sóc các ngươi [vì] điều ác trong việc làm của các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy về những người chăn đang chăn dắt dân Ta: Các ngươi đã làm tan tác đàn chiên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và xua đuổi chúng, mà không chăm sóc chúng. Vậy nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chăm sóc các ngươi, và phạt điều ác các ngươi đã làm, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán với những người chăn coi sóc dân Ta: Các ngươi đã làm tan lạc bầy chiên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và xua đuổi chúng. Các ngươi không chăm sóc chúng. Vậy bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chăm sóc các ngươi: Ta sẽ phạt các ngươi vì những điều gian ác các ngươi đã làm, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그러므로 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 백성을 치는 목자들에 대하여 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희가 내 양 떼를 흩어 버리고 쫓아내고 돌보지 않았다. 보아라, 내가 너희 행실의 악을 너희에게 돌보겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 백성을 치는 목자들에 대하여 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희가 내 양 떼를 흩어 버리고 쫓아내고 돌보지 않았다. 이제 내가 너희를 돌보겠다. 너희가 저지른 악행을 벌하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그래서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 백성을 돌보는 목자들에게 하시는 말씀이다. 너희는 내 양 떼를 흩어 버리고 쫓아냈다. 너희는 그들을 돌보지 않았다. 이제는 내가 너희를 돌보아 주겠다. 너희가 저지른 악한 일 때문에 너희를 벌하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Portanto, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, a respeito dos pastores que pastoreiam o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo: Vocês dispersaram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rebanho e os afugentaram, e não cuidaram deles; eis que eu vou cuidar de vocês [pela] maldade das suas ações, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Por isso, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, a respeito dos pastores que pastoreiam o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo: Vocês dispersaram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rebanho e o espantaram, e não cuidaram dele. Pois agora eu vou cuidar de vocês e castigar o mal que vocês fizeram, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Por isso, é isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, diz aos pastores que tomam conta do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo: Vocês espalharam o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rebanho e o espantaram. Vocês não tomaram conta dele. Pois agora eu vou tomar conta de vocês: vou castigá-los pelas coisas más que fizeram, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: attend to: the same verb for caring for the flock and for punishing its shepherds
decisions.reason: The verb means to give attention to someone, either to care for them or to deal with them for what they have done. The shepherds have not given the flock attention, so God will give them attention, for their evil deeds. The play continues in verse 4, where none of the flock will be "missing" (the same verb again).

decisions.choice: scattered ... driven them away: what the shepherds' rule has led to
decisions.reason: The rulers' bad leadership is blamed for the scattering of the people. In verse 3 God says he himself drove them out: the exile is his judgment, and the rulers' failure brought it on.

decisions.choice: looked after ... look after (Balanced); take care of ... take care of (Readable), then "punish"
decisions.reason: The same English verb is used twice to keep the play on the Hebrew verb, and "punish" makes plain what the second "looking after" means.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD (Literal); The LORD says this (Balanced); This is what the LORD says (Readable)
decisions.reason: The book's settled wording for the formula at each level.

decisions.choice: atendido ... atender[los] (Literal); cuidado ... me ocuparé de (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew verb means caring for the flock and calling the shepherds to account (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps one Spanish verb, "atender", for both; Balanced and Readable use "ocuparse de", which can carry both senses, and then say "castigar".

decisions.choice: hamkuwaangalia ... nitawaangalia ninyi
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one verb for both halves, as the Hebrew does (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable say "kutunza" for the care that was not given and "kushughulikia ... kuadhibu" for the punishment.

decisions.choice: "vous ne vous êtes pas occupés ... je vais m'occuper de vous"
alternatives: vous n'avez pas pris soin ... je vais vous punir
decisions.reason: French "s'occuper de" can mean both caring for and dealing with someone, so it keeps the play on the Hebrew verb; Balanced and Readable then add "punir" to make the second sense plain, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "chăm sóc" twice, for caring and for punishing
decisions.reason: One Vietnamese verb carries both uses, as the Hebrew does (meaning decision m1): the shepherds did not "chăm sóc" the flock, so God will "chăm sóc" them; Balanced and Readable then say "phạt", as the English adds "punish".

decisions.choice: "돌보다" twice, for caring for the flock and for dealing with the shepherds
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses one verb for both (meaning decision m1). Korean keeps "돌보다" both times so the irony can be heard; Balanced and Readable add "벌하다" to make plain what God's "attending" means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "치다" (L, B); "돌보다" (R) for shepherding
decisions.reason: "양을 치다" is the Korean phrase for tending sheep; Readable uses the plainer "돌보다".

decisions.choice: cuidar de ... cuidar de (L, B); tomar conta de ... tomar conta de (R), then castigar
decisions.reason: The one verb means both to care for and to deal with someone for what they did (m1). Portuguese repeats one verb at each level, as the English does, so the play is kept: the shepherds did not "cuidar" of the flock, so God will "cuidar" of them; Balanced and Readable then say "castigar", which makes the second sense plain.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֗י אֲקַבֵּץ֙ אֶת־שְׁאֵרִ֣ית צֹאנִ֔י מִכֹּל֙ הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִדַּ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖ם שָׁ֑ם וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י אֶתְהֶ֛ן עַל־נְוֵהֶ֖ן וּפָר֥וּ וְרָבֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will gather [the] remnant of my flock from all the lands where I have driven them there, and I will bring them back to their pasture, and they will be fruitful and multiply.

en.L: And I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will gather the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} flock from all the lands where I have driven them, and I will bring them back to their fold, and they will be fruitful and multiply.
en.B: I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will gather together the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} flock from every country to which I have driven them, and I will bring them back to their grazing land, and they will be fruitful and increase.
en.R: Then I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will gather the rest of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} flock from all the countries where I have scattered them. I will bring them back to their own pasture, and they will have many young and grow in number.

es.L: Y yo mismo reuniré el remanente de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rebaño de todas las tierras adonde los he echado, y los haré volver a su redil, y fructificarán y se multiplicarán.
es.B: Yo mismo reuniré el remanente de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rebaño de todos los países adonde los he echado, y los haré volver a sus pastos, y serán fecundos y se multiplicarán.
es.R: Entonces yo mismo reuniré a los que queden de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rebaño de todos los países adonde los he dispersado. Los traeré de vuelta a sus propios pastos, y tendrán muchas crías y aumentarán en número.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je rassemblerai le reste de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} troupeau de tous les pays où je les ai chassées, et je les ramènerai dans leur enclos, et elles seront fécondes et se multiplieront.
fr.B: Moi-même, je rassemblerai le reste de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} troupeau de tous les pays où je l’ai chassé, et je le ramènerai dans ses pâturages ; il sera fécond et s’accroîtra.
fr.R: Alors, {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, je rassemblerai ce qui reste de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} troupeau, de tous les pays où je l’ai dispersé. Je le ramènerai dans son pâturage, et les brebis auront beaucoup de petits et deviendront nombreuses.

sw.L: Nami {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitayakusanya mabaki ya kondoo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kutoka nchi zote nilizowafukuzia, nami nitawarudisha kwenye zizi lao, nao watazaa na kuongezeka.
sw.B: Mimi {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitayakusanya pamoja mabaki ya kundi {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kutoka kila nchi nilikowafukuzia, nami nitawarudisha kwenye malisho yao, nao watazaa na kuongezeka.
sw.R: Kisha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitawakusanya kondoo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} waliobaki kutoka nchi zote nilikowatawanya. Nitawarudisha kwenye malisho yao wenyewe, nao watazaa watoto wengi na kuongezeka idadi.

vi.L: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm số sót lại của bầy chiên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} từ mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xua đuổi chúng đến, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem chúng về lại chuồng của chúng, và chúng sẽ sinh sản và gia tăng.
vi.B: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tập hợp những con chiên còn sót lại trong đàn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} từ mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xua đuổi chúng đến, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem chúng về lại đồng cỏ của chúng; chúng sẽ sinh sôi nảy nở và gia tăng.
vi.R: Rồi chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tập hợp những con chiên còn lại của đàn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} từ mọi xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho chúng tan lạc. Ta sẽ đem chúng về lại đồng cỏ của chúng, và chúng sẽ sinh nhiều con và trở nên đông đúc.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 친히 내가 그들을 쫓아낸 모든 땅에서 내 양 떼의 남은 자를 모아 그들의 우리로 돌아오게 하겠다. 그들은 생육하고 번성할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 친히 내 양 떼 가운데 남은 것들을 내가 쫓아 보낸 모든 나라에서 모아, 그들이 살던 풀밭으로 돌아오게 하겠다. 그들은 새끼를 많이 낳고 불어날 것이다.
ko.R: 그런 다음 내가 직접 내 양 떼 가운데 남은 것들을 모으겠다. 내가 그들을 흩어 보낸 모든 나라에서 모으겠다. 내가 그들을 그들의 풀밭으로 데려오겠다. 그들은 새끼를 많이 낳고 수가 늘어날 것이다.

pt.L: E eu mesmo ajuntarei o remanescente do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rebanho de todas as terras para onde eu os expulsei, e os farei voltar ao seu aprisco, e eles serão fecundos e se multiplicarão.
pt.B: Eu mesmo reunirei o remanescente do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rebanho de todos os países para onde os expulsei, e os farei voltar às suas pastagens, e eles serão fecundos e se multiplicarão.
pt.R: Então eu mesmo vou reunir o resto do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} rebanho de todos os países para onde os espalhei. Vou trazê-los de volta para a pastagem deles, e eles vão ter muitas crias e aumentar em número.

decisions.choice: I myself: God takes over the shepherds' work
decisions.reason: The word "I" is stressed. Where the rulers scattered the flock, God himself will gather it (31:10; Ezekiel 34:11-16). He also says that he is the one who drove them out: the exile came from him as judgment.

decisions.choice: remnant: those left after the judgment
decisions.reason: The word means what is left over. It is used for the people who survive war and exile (6:9; 24:8; Isaiah 10:20-22).

decisions.choice: be fruitful and multiply: the first blessing restored
decisions.reason: These are the words of God's blessing at creation and to Noah and Abraham's family (Genesis 1:28; 9:1; 35:11). Back in their land, the people will grow again as God first intended (3:16).

decisions.choice: pasture: the place where the flock lives and grazes
decisions.reason: The word means a grazing place or the home of a flock, and so also a dwelling (10:25; 33:12).

decisions.choice: have many young and grow in number
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture of the flock instead of the older phrase "be fruitful and multiply".

decisions.choice: el remanente (Literal, Balanced); los que queden (Readable)
decisions.reason: The remnant keeps the wording the terms note sets for the prophets.

decisions.choice: mabaki (Literal, Balanced); waliobaki (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for the remnant (Romans 9:27; 2 Kings 19:31).

decisions.choice: "le reste" (L, B); "ce qui reste" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant as the terms note sets it, with "ce qui reste" at Readable for the flock.

decisions.choice: "số sót lại" (L); "những con chiên còn sót lại" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The remnant is spoken of within the picture of the flock, so Balanced and Readable keep the sheep; Literal uses the terms note's "số sót lại".

decisions.choice: "남은 자" (L); "남은 것들" (B, R) for the remnant
decisions.reason: The terms note's Literal word for *sheʾerit*. Balanced and Readable keep the picture of the flock, so the remnant are "the ones left" among the sheep.

decisions.choice: o remanescente (L, B); o resto (R)
decisions.reason: As set at 6:9, after Isaiah 10:20: the part of the people left after the judgment (m2) is "o remanescente" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "o resto", as the English Readable says "the rest".

source.text: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֧י עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם רֹעִ֖ים וְרָע֑וּם וְלֹא־יִֽירְא֨וּ ע֧וֹד וְלֹא־יֵחַ֛תּוּ וְלֹ֥א יִפָּקֵ֖דוּ נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will raise up over them shepherds and they will shepherd them, and not they will fear again and not be dismayed and not be missing, declares Yahweh.

en.L: And I will raise up shepherds over them, and they will shepherd them; and they will no longer fear or be dismayed, and none will be missing, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will set shepherds over them who will truly tend them. They will no longer be afraid or terrified, and not one of them will be lost, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will give them shepherds who will take care of them. They will not be afraid or frightened anymore, and not one of them will be missing, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y levantaré sobre ellos pastores que los apacienten, y no temerán más, ni se espantarán, ni faltará ninguna, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pondré sobre ellos pastores que de verdad los cuiden. Ya no tendrán miedo ni se aterrarán, y no se perderá ni una sola, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Les daré pastores que los cuiden. Ya no tendrán miedo ni se asustarán, y no faltará ni una de ellas, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et je susciterai sur elles des bergers, et ils les feront paître ; et elles n’auront plus peur et ne seront plus effrayées, et aucune ne manquera, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: J’établirai sur elles des bergers qui en prendront vraiment soin. Elles n’auront plus peur, elles ne seront plus terrifiées, et pas une ne sera perdue, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je leur donnerai des bergers qui prendront soin d’elles. Elles n’auront plus peur, elles ne seront plus effrayées, et il n’en manquera pas une seule, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitawainulia wachungaji juu yao, nao watawachunga; wala hawataogopa tena, wala hawatafadhaika, wala hatapotea hata mmoja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitaweka juu yao wachungaji watakaowachunga kweli. Hawataogopa tena wala hawatatishika, wala hatapotea hata mmoja wao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitawapa wachungaji watakaowatunza. Hawataogopa tena wala kutishika, wala hatakosekana hata mmoja wao, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ta sẽ lập những người chăn trên chúng, và họ sẽ chăn dắt chúng; chúng sẽ không còn sợ hãi hay kinh khiếp nữa, và không con nào bị thiếu mất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Ta sẽ lập những người chăn thật lòng chăm nom chúng. Chúng sẽ không còn sợ hãi hay kinh hoàng nữa, và không một con nào bị lạc mất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Ta sẽ ban cho chúng những người chăn biết chăm sóc chúng. Chúng sẽ không còn sợ hãi hay hoảng hốt nữa, và không một con nào bị thiếu, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 그들 위에 목자들을 세워 그들을 치게 하겠다. 그들은 다시는 두려워하거나 놀라지 않을 것이고, 하나도 잃어버리지 않을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 내가 그들 위에 목자들을 세워 그들을 제대로 돌보게 하겠다. 그들은 다시는 두려워하거나 겁에 질리지 않을 것이고, 하나도 없어지지 않을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 내가 그들에게 그들을 잘 돌볼 목자들을 주겠다. 그들은 더 이상 두려워하거나 무서워하지 않을 것이다. 하나도 잃어버리지 않을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E levantarei sobre eles pastores, e eles os pastorearão; e não temerão mais, nem se apavorarão, e nenhum faltará, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Porei sobre eles pastores que vão de fato cuidar deles. Eles não terão mais medo nem pavor, e nenhum deles se perderá, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Vou dar a eles pastores que vão tomar conta deles. Eles não vão mais ter medo nem ficar apavorados, e nenhum deles vai faltar, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: shepherds: new rulers, given by God
decisions.reason: God promised "shepherds after my own heart" in 3:15. Here they come before the promise of one king from David's line (verse 5); the good king and the good leaders belong together.

decisions.choice: be missing: the third use of the verb in verses 2-4
decisions.reason: The verb of verse 2 ("attend to") here means to be looked for and not found, as when a flock is counted (1 Samuel 25:7). Under the new shepherds no sheep will be lost.

decisions.choice: truly tend them
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "truly" to bring out the contrast with the shepherds of verses 1-2, who did not look after the flock.

source.text: הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י לְדָוִ֖ד צֶ֣מַח צַדִּ֑יק וּמָ֤לַךְ מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ וְהִשְׂכִּ֔יל וְעָשָׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, days [are] coming, declares Yahweh, and I will raise up for David a branch righteous, and he will reign [as] king and act wisely, and do justice and righteousness in the land.

en.L: Look, days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, \q and he will reign as king and act wisely, \q and do justice and righteousness in the land.
en.B: The days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q when I will raise a righteous Branch for David. \q He will reign as king and rule with wisdom, \q and he will do justice and righteousness in the land.
en.R: The time is coming, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q when I will give David a righteous Branch, a king from his family. \q He will rule as king, and he will rule wisely. \q He will do what is just and righteous in the land.

es.L: He aquí vienen días, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q en que levantaré a David un Retoño justo, \q y reinará como rey y obrará sabiamente, \q y hará derecho y justicia en la tierra.
es.B: Vienen días, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q en que haré brotar para David un Retoño justo. \q Reinará como rey y gobernará con sabiduría, \q y practicará el derecho y la justicia en la tierra.
es.R: Se acerca el tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q en que le daré a David un Retoño justo, un rey de su familia. \q Él reinará como rey, y gobernará con sabiduría. \q Hará lo que es justo y correcto en la tierra.

fr.L: Voici, des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q où je susciterai pour David un Germe juste ; \q il régnera en roi et agira avec sagesse, \q et il pratiquera le droit et la justice dans le pays.
fr.B: Des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q où je ferai lever pour David un Germe juste. \q Il régnera en roi et gouvernera avec sagesse ; \q il exercera le droit et la justice dans le pays.
fr.R: Un temps vient, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q où je donnerai à David un Germe juste, un roi de sa famille. \q Il régnera comme roi, et il gouvernera avec sagesse. \q Il fera ce qui est juste et droit dans le pays.

sw.L: Tazama, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nitakapomwinulia Daudi Chipukizi la haki, \q naye atatawala kama mfalme na kutenda kwa hekima, \q na kufanya hukumu na haki katika nchi.
sw.B: Siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nitakapomwinulia Daudi Chipukizi la haki. \q Atatawala kama mfalme na kuongoza kwa hekima, \q naye atatenda haki na uadilifu katika nchi.
sw.R: Wakati unakuja, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nitakapompa Daudi Chipukizi la haki, mfalme kutoka ukoo wake. \q Atatawala kama mfalme, naye atatawala kwa hekima. \q Atatenda yaliyo ya haki na adili katika nchi.

vi.L: Kìa, những ngày đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dấy lên cho Đa-vít một Chồi công chính; \q Người sẽ trị vì làm vua và hành động khôn ngoan, \q và thi hành công lý và sự công chính trong xứ.
vi.B: Sẽ đến những ngày, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q Ta sẽ dấy lên cho Đa-vít một Chồi công chính. \q Người sẽ trị vì làm vua và cai trị cách khôn ngoan; \q Người sẽ thi hành công lý và sự công chính trong xứ.
vi.R: Sẽ đến lúc, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, \q Ta sẽ ban cho Đa-vít một Chồi công chính, là một vị vua thuộc dòng dõi ông. \q Người sẽ làm vua và cai trị cách khôn ngoan. \q Người sẽ làm điều công bằng và ngay thẳng trong xứ.

ko.L: 보아라, 날들이 온다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 그때에 내가 다윗에게 의로운 싹을 일으키겠다. \q 그는 왕으로 다스리며 지혜롭게 행하고, \q 그 땅에서 정의와 의를 행할 것이다.
ko.B: 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그때에 내가 다윗에게서 의로운 싹이 돋아나게 하겠다. \q 그는 왕이 되어 지혜롭게 다스리고, \q 그 땅에서 정의와 의를 행할 것이다.
ko.R: 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그때에 내가 다윗의 집안에서 왕을 일으키겠다. 그는 의로운 싹이다. \q 그는 왕이 되어 지혜롭게 다스릴 것이다. \q 그 땅에서 옳고 바른 일을 할 것이다.

pt.L: Eis que vêm dias, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q em que levantarei para Davi um Renovo justo, \q e ele reinará como rei e agirá com sabedoria, \q e praticará a justiça e a retidão na terra.
pt.B: Vêm dias, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q em que farei brotar para Davi um Renovo justo. \q Ele reinará como rei e governará com sabedoria, \q e praticará a justiça e a retidão na terra.
pt.R: Está chegando o tempo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q em que vou dar a Davi um Renovo justo, um rei da família dele. \q Ele vai reinar como rei e vai governar com sabedoria. \q Vai fazer o que é justo e certo na terra.

decisions.choice: a righteous Branch for David: a coming king from David's line
decisions.reason: A branch is new growth that springs from a plant. God promises a king who will come from the family of David, though the kings of chapter 22 have failed and Coniah's line is cut off (22:30). Jeremiah repeats this promise in 33:15, and later prophets use "Branch" as a title for the coming king (Zechariah 3:8; 6:12; compare Isaiah 4:2; 11:1). The New Testament sees God's promise to David fulfilled in Jesus (Luke 1:32-33).

decisions.choice: righteous: a king who is himself in the right and rules rightly
decisions.reason: The word can mean a rightful or legitimate heir, and it also means one who does what is right. Both fit: the king will be the true heir of David, and he will do what the last kings did not (22:3, 13-17).

decisions.choice: act wisely: rule with good sense, and so succeed
decisions.reason: The verb means to act with insight, and so also to prosper (Joshua 1:7-8; 1 Samuel 18:14). A wise ruler is a successful one. The other king named in 22:30 will "not prosper" (a different verb).

decisions.choice: do justice and righteousness: what God asks of a king
decisions.reason: God told the kings of Judah to do justice and righteousness (22:3), and praised Josiah for doing it (22:15). David himself did so (2 Samuel 8:15). The promised king will do what his fathers were called to do.

decisions.choice: Branch, with a capital letter
decisions.reason: The capital letter marks the word as a title for the king, as in 33:15. Isaiah 4:2 uses the same Hebrew word in a passage where it may mean the land's new crops, and there it stays lowercase.

decisions.choice: a king from his family
decisions.reason: Readable says who the Branch is, from the rest of the verse.

decisions.choice: un Retoño justo, capitalized
decisions.reason: The title of the coming king (meaning decision m1) is "Retoño" with a capital letter, as the terms note sets for 23:5 and 33:15; Readable adds "un rey de su familia", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Chipukizi la haki
decisions.reason: "Chipukizi" with a capital, as the title of the coming king; the terms note keeps it for 23:5 and 33:15, so the two promises read alike.

decisions.choice: "un Germe juste", with a capital, at every level; Readable adds "un roi de sa famille"
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for tsemach in Jeremiah 23:5 and 33:15: the capital marks it as a title of the king to come.

decisions.choice: "Chồi công chính"; the king is "Người", capitalised, with no span
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the Branch of 23:5 and 33:15. As the English writes "he" plainly, the coming king takes the respectful capital "Người" as a title of honour but no deity_pronoun setting, as the terms note rules for the king of Isaiah 9 and 11.

decisions.choice: "의로운 싹"
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps *tsemach* "싹" at every level (Isaiah 4:2; Jeremiah 23:5; 33:15) so the passages stay linked. Korean has no capital letters; the title is carried by the words alone.

decisions.choice: No honorific for the coming king ("다스리며", "행할 것이다")
decisions.reason: God is speaking of the king he will raise up; as with the king of Isaiah 11:1 and the servant in the terms note, the king is spoken of without "-시-".

decisions.choice: um Renovo justo, with a capital
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 33:15): tsemach is the coming king from David's line (m1), so Portuguese says "Renovo", the word for new growth that springs from a cut plant, with a capital as a title, as the English writes "Branch". Isaiah 4:2 keeps "o broto" in lowercase because there the meaning is left open, and names this verse as the place where the title is used; Isaiah 11:1's "rebento" and "ramo" translate other Hebrew words. "Um", as the Hebrew has no article.

records.literal_gloss: In his days will be saved Judah and Israel will dwell in security; and this [is] his name which he will call him: Yahweh [is] our righteousness.

en.L: In his days Judah will be saved, \q and Israel will dwell in security; \q and this [is] his name that one will call him: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] our righteousness."
en.B: In his days Judah will be saved, \q and Israel will live in safety. \q And this is the name people will give him: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} Is Our Righteousness."
en.R: While he is king, Judah will be saved, \q and Israel will live in safety. \q People will call him by this name: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} Is Our Righteousness."

es.L: En sus días será salvo Judá, \q e Israel habitará seguro; \q y este [es] su nombre con que lo llamarán: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] nuestra justicia».
es.B: En sus días Judá será salvado, \q e Israel vivirá seguro. \q Y este es el nombre que le darán: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Es Nuestra Justicia».
es.R: Mientras él sea rey, Judá será salvado, \q e Israel vivirá seguro. \q La gente lo llamará con este nombre: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Es Nuestra Justicia».

fr.L: Dans ses jours Juda sera sauvé, \q et Israël habitera en sécurité ; \q et voici le nom dont on l’appellera : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] notre justice. »
fr.B: En son temps, Juda sera sauvé, \q et Israël vivra en sécurité. \q Et voici le nom qu’on lui donnera : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}-notre-justice. »
fr.R: Pendant son règne, Juda sera sauvé, \q et Israël vivra en sécurité. \q On l’appellera par ce nom : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}-notre-justice. »

sw.L: Katika siku zake Yuda ataokolewa, \q na Israeli atakaa salama; \q na hili [ndilo] jina lake atakaloitwa: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] haki yetu."
sw.B: Katika siku zake Yuda ataokolewa, \q na Israeli ataishi salama. \q Na hili ndilo jina watu watakalompa: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Ni Haki Yetu."
sw.R: Wakati atakapokuwa mfalme, Yuda ataokolewa, \q na Israeli ataishi salama. \q Watu watamwita kwa jina hili: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Ni Haki Yetu."

vi.L: Trong thời Người, Giu-đa sẽ được cứu, \q và Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ ở yên ổn; \q và đây [là] danh mà người ta sẽ gọi Người: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] sự công chính của chúng ta."
vi.B: Trong thời Người, Giu-đa sẽ được cứu, \q và Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ sống an ninh. \q Đây là danh người ta sẽ đặt cho Người: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Là Sự Công Chính Của Chúng Ta."
vi.R: Khi Người làm vua, Giu-đa sẽ được cứu, \q và Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ sống an toàn. \q Người ta sẽ gọi Người bằng danh này: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Là Sự Công Chính Của Chúng Ta."

ko.L: 그의 날에 유다가 구원을 받고, \q 이스라엘이 안전하게 살 것이다. \q 사람들이 그를 부를 그의 이름은 이것이다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 우리의 의."
ko.B: 그가 다스리는 날에 유다가 구원을 받고, \q 이스라엘이 평안히 살 것이다. \q 사람들은 그를 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 우리의 의"라는 이름으로 부를 것이다.
ko.R: 그가 왕으로 있는 동안 유다는 구원을 받고, \q 이스라엘은 안전하게 살 것이다. \q 사람들은 그를 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 우리의 의"라고 부를 것이다.

pt.L: Nos seus dias Judá será salvo, \q e Israel habitará em segurança; \q e este [é] o seu nome com que o chamarão: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} [é] a nossa justiça."
pt.B: Nos seus dias Judá será salvo, \q e Israel viverá em segurança. \q E este é o nome que lhe darão: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} É a Nossa Justiça."
pt.R: Enquanto ele for rei, Judá vai ser salvo, \q e Israel vai viver em segurança. \q As pessoas vão chamá-lo por este nome: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} É a Nossa Justiça."

decisions.choice: The LORD is our righteousness: a name that says what God will do for his people
decisions.reason: The name is a sentence: the LORD is the one who gives his people what is right and puts them in the right. Righteousness here is more than a quality of God; it is his saving justice, which sets his people free and makes things right (Isaiah 45:24-25; 46:13). The same name is given to Jerusalem in 33:16.

decisions.choice: a play on the name of King Zedekiah
decisions.reason: The last king of Judah, Zedekiah, was set on the throne by Babylon (2 Kings 24:17). His name means "the LORD is my righteousness" or "the LORD is righteous". The name of the promised king turns the same two words around: what Zedekiah's name claimed and his reign never showed, the coming king will truly be. The text does not name Zedekiah here, but the likeness of the two names is close and hard to miss.

decisions.choice: that one will call him: people in general will call him
alternatives: which the LORD will call him
decisions.reason: The verb is "he will call him" with no subject named, the Hebrew way of saying "he will be called". The Septuagint seems to have read the subject as the LORD and gives a different name, close to "Josedek" (this is from general knowledge). The Hebrew is kept.

decisions.choice: Judah and Israel: the whole people, south and north, together again
decisions.reason: Israel, the northern kingdom, had been taken into exile long before (2 Kings 17). Jeremiah promises that both parts of the nation will be restored together (3:18; 31:27, 31).

decisions.choice: The LORD Is Our Righteousness, written as a name
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable set the words out as a proper name with capitals; Literal shows the bare Hebrew with the verb supplied. The same wording is used in 33:16.

decisions.choice: While he is king
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in his days" means: during his reign.

decisions.choice: El SEÑOR Es Nuestra Justicia, written as a name
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable write the name with capitals, as the English does. The name echoes King Zedekiah's, "Sedequías" (meaning decision m2), which Spanish cannot show.

decisions.choice: BWANA Ni Haki Yetu
decisions.reason: Written as a name with capitals at Balanced and Readable, as the English does; "haki" is the settled Swahili for *tsedeq*.

decisions.choice: "Le SEIGNEUR-notre-justice", written as a name with hyphens (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English sets the words out as a proper name, French joins them with hyphens, as for "Terreur-de-tous-côtés" (20:3); Literal keeps the bare Hebrew with the verb supplied. The same wording returns in 33:16.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA Là Sự Công Chính Của Chúng Ta", written as a name
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable write the words as a name with capitals; Literal keeps a sentence with the supplied "[là]". The divine name keeps its setting inside the title.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 우리의 의"
decisions.reason: The name is translated, as the English does, so its meaning can be heard (meaning decision m1); with the setting it reads "야훼는 우리의 의", close to the Hebrew name. The particle "는" fits both forms.

decisions.choice: a nossa justiça; capitals at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The name (m1) says that the LORD gives his people what is right and puts them in the right, and "justiça" is the Portuguese word that carries that sense, the word of Romans for God's righteousness; "retidão", which this book uses beside "justiça" for the pair in verse 5, would describe only conduct. It keeps the play on the name of Zedequias (m2) for a reader who knows that his name means much the same. Balanced and Readable write it as a name, with capitals, as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore look, days [are] coming, declares Yahweh, and not they will say again, [By the] life of Yahweh who brought up [the] sons of Israel from [the] land of Egypt,

en.L: Therefore, look, days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when they will no longer say, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, who brought up the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel from the land of Egypt,"
en.B: Therefore, the days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when it will no longer be said, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, who brought up the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} from the land of Egypt,"
en.R: So a time is coming, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when people will no longer make a promise by saying, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, the God who led the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} out of Egypt."

es.L: Por tanto, he aquí vienen días, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que no dirán más: «Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hizo subir a los hijos de Israel de la tierra de Egipto»,
es.B: Por eso vienen días, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que ya no se dirá: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que sacó a los israelitas de la tierra de Egipto»,
es.R: Por eso se acerca el tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que la gente ya no hará promesas diciendo: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios que sacó a los israelitas de Egipto».

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, voici, des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où l’on ne dira plus : « [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, qui a fait monter les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël du pays d’Égypte »,
fr.B: C’est pourquoi des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où l’on ne dira plus : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, lui qui a fait monter les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} du pays d’Égypte »,
fr.R: C’est pourquoi un temps vient, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où les gens ne feront plus de promesse en disant : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, le Dieu qui a fait sortir les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} d’Égypte. »

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, tazama, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo hawatasema tena, "[Kama] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, aliyewapandisha wana wa Israeli kutoka nchi ya Misri,"
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo haitasemwa tena, "Hakika kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, aliyewapandisha Waisraeli kutoka nchi ya Misri,"
sw.R: Kwa hiyo wakati unakuja, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo watu hawataahidi tena kwa kusema, "Hakika kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, Mungu aliyewatoa Waisraeli Misri."

vi.L: Vì vậy, kìa, những ngày đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, khi người ta sẽ không còn nói: "[Thật như] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đấng đã đem con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi xứ Ai Cập,"
vi.B: Vì vậy, sẽ đến những ngày, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, người ta sẽ không còn nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đấng đã đem dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi xứ Ai Cập,"
vi.R: Vậy sẽ đến lúc, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, người ta sẽ không còn thề hứa bằng câu: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, là Đức Chúa Trời đã dẫn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi Ai Cập."

ko.L: 그러므로 보아라, 날들이 온다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그때에는 사람들이 다시는 "이스라엘 자손을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 올리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 [두고]" 하고 말하지 않고,
ko.B: 그러므로 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그때에는 사람들이 다시는 "이스라엘 자손을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세한다." 하고 말하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그때에는 사람들이 약속을 할 때에 다시는 "이스라엘 자손을 이집트에서 이끌어 내신 하나님, 살아 계신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두고 맹세한다." 하고 말하지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Por isso, eis que vêm dias, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, em que não se dirá mais: "[Tão certo como] vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que fez subir os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito",
pt.B: Por isso, vêm dias, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, em que não se dirá mais: "Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que fez subir os israelitas da terra do Egito",
pt.R: Por isso, está chegando um tempo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, em que as pessoas não vão mais fazer juramentos dizendo: "Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus que tirou os israelitas do Egito."

decisions.choice: verses 7-8 repeat 16:14-15
decisions.reason: These two verses say almost word for word what 16:14-15 says, and the wording at every level is kept the same wherever the Hebrew is the same. There the promise follows a word of judgment; here it follows the promise of the king and the gathering of the flock (verses 3-6). In this verse the one difference is "they will say" where 16:14 has "it will be said"; verse 8 notes the rest.

decisions.choice: As the LORD lives: the form of a solemn oath
decisions.reason: An Israelite swore by the life of the LORD (4:2; 5:2; 12:16). The words that follow name him by his greatest act until now: bringing Israel out of Egypt.

decisions.choice: a new exodus that will outshine the first
decisions.reason: The return from exile will be so great that people will name God by it instead of by the exodus from Egypt (16:14-15; Isaiah 43:16-19).

decisions.choice: [As] the LORD lives (L); As surely as the LORD lives (B, R); Readable adds "make a promise by saying" and "the God who led"
decisions.reason: The same wording as 16:14, so that the repeated verses read alike. Balanced also gives "they will no longer say" as 16:14 gives its Hebrew, "it will no longer be said"; the impersonal sense is the same.

decisions.choice: Vive el SEÑOR (Literal); Tan cierto como que vive el SEÑOR (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The oath formula keeps the Samuel note's wording.

decisions.choice: los hijos de Israel / los israelitas
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" and "israelitas" already include women, so no gender span is needed where the English has one.

decisions.choice: [Kama] BWANA aishivyo (Literal); Hakika kama BWANA aishivyo (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording used for this oath in this block. "Wana wa Israeli" and "Waisraeli" already include women and men, so Swahili has no gender alternative.

decisions.choice: "[Aussi vrai que] le SEIGNEUR est vivant" (L); "Aussi vrai que le SEIGNEUR est vivant" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath formula as Samuel and Kings give it in French.

decisions.choice: "les enfants d'Israël" (L), "les Israélites" (B, R), with "fils d'Israël" as the gender alternative
decisions.reason: As the published French books: the whole people is meant, so the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: "Thật như CHÚA hằng sống"; "con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L), "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The oath formula is worded as God's own "Thật như Ta hằng sống" of 22:24. Vietnamese "con cái" and "dân" already include women, so the English gender alternative has no second wording here.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "자손" already means descendants of either sex, so Korean has no second wording to offer for the English gender setting.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세한다" for the oath "As the LORD lives"
decisions.reason: The form of a solemn oath (meaning decision m2) in modern Korean; Literal leaves the verb in brackets, as the Hebrew has none.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender span
alternatives: {{gender:os filhos e as filhas de Israel|os filhos de Israel}}
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms set it: "os filhos de Israel" and "os israelitas" already take in women and men, so Portuguese has no second wording for the gender setting, unlike the English "children/sons". Verses 7-8 keep the Portuguese of 16:14-15 at each level wherever the Hebrew is the same, as the English does (m1).

source.text: כִּ֣י אִם־חַי־יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱלָה֩ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יא אֶת־זֶ֨רַע בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹנָה וּמִכֹּל֙ הָֽאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדַּחְתִּ֖ים שָׁ֑ם וְיָשְׁב֖וּ עַל־אַדְמָתָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: but rather [by the] life of Yahweh who brought up and who brought [the] offspring of [the] house of Israel from [the] land of [the] north and from all the lands where I had driven them there; and they will dwell on their land.

en.L: but, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands where I had driven them." And they will dwell on their own land.
en.B: but, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, who brought up and led the descendants of the house of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands where I had driven them." Then they will live in their own land.
en.R: Instead they will say, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, the God who led the descendants of Israel out of the land in the north and out of all the countries where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had scattered them." Then they will live in their own land.

es.L: sino: «Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hizo subir y que trajo a la descendencia de la casa de Israel de la tierra del norte y de todas las tierras adonde yo los había echado». Y habitarán en su propia tierra.
es.B: sino: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hizo subir y trajo a los descendientes de la casa de Israel de la tierra del norte y de todas las tierras adonde yo los había echado». Entonces vivirán en su propia tierra.
es.R: Más bien dirán: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios que sacó a los descendientes de Israel de la tierra del norte y de todos los países adonde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los había dispersado». Entonces vivirán en su propia tierra.

fr.L: mais : « [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, qui a fait monter et qui a ramené la descendance de la maison d’Israël du pays du nord et de tous les pays où je les avais chassés. » Et ils habiteront sur leur propre terre.
fr.B: mais : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, lui qui a fait monter et ramené la descendance de la maison d’Israël du pays du nord et de tous les pays où je les avais chassés. » Alors ils habiteront dans leur propre pays.
fr.R: Ils diront plutôt : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, le Dieu qui a fait sortir les descendants d’Israël du pays du nord et de tous les pays où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les avait dispersés. » Alors ils habiteront dans leur propre pays.

sw.L: bali, "[Kama] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, aliyewapandisha na aliyewaongoza uzao wa nyumba ya Israeli kutoka nchi ya kaskazini na kutoka nchi zote nilizokuwa nimewafukuzia." Nao watakaa katika nchi yao wenyewe.
sw.B: bali, "Hakika kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, aliyewapandisha na kuwaongoza wazao wa nyumba ya Israeli kutoka nchi ya kaskazini na kutoka nchi zote nilizokuwa nimewafukuzia." Ndipo watakaa katika nchi yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Badala yake watasema, "Hakika kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, Mungu aliyewatoa wazao wa Israeli katika nchi ya kaskazini na katika nchi zote alizokuwa amewatawanyia." Ndipo wataishi katika nchi yao wenyewe.

vi.L: nhưng: "[Thật như] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đấng đã đem lên và dẫn dòng dõi nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên về từ xứ phương bắc và từ mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xua đuổi chúng đến." Rồi chúng sẽ ở trên đất của mình.
vi.B: nhưng: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đấng đã đem lên và dẫn dắt dòng dõi nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên về từ xứ phương bắc và từ mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xua đuổi chúng đến." Bấy giờ chúng sẽ sống trên đất của mình.
vi.R: Thay vào đó, họ sẽ nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, là Đức Chúa Trời đã dẫn dòng dõi Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi xứ phương bắc và khỏi mọi xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho họ tan lạc." Bấy giờ họ sẽ sống trên đất của mình.

ko.L: "이스라엘 집의 자손을 북쪽 땅과 내가 그들을 쫓아냈던 모든 땅에서 이끌어 올리시고 데려오신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 [두고]" 하고 말할 것이다. 그리고 그들은 자기 땅에서 살 것이다.
ko.B: 오히려 "이스라엘 집의 자손을 북쪽 땅과 내가 그들을 쫓아냈던 모든 나라에서 이끌어 내어 데려오신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세한다." 하고 말할 것이다. 그때에 그들은 자기 땅에서 살 것이다.
ko.R: 오히려 "이스라엘 자손을 북쪽 땅에서, 그리고 그분이 그들을 흩으셨던 모든 나라에서 이끌어 내신 하나님, 살아 계신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두고 맹세한다." 하고 말할 것이다. 그때에 그들은 자기 땅에서 살 것이다.

pt.L: mas: "[Tão certo como] vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que fez subir e que trouxe a descendência da casa de Israel da terra do norte e de todas as terras para onde eu os tinha expulsado." E eles habitarão na sua [própria] terra.
pt.B: mas: "Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que fez subir e trouxe os descendentes da casa de Israel da terra do norte e de todas as terras para onde eu os tinha expulsado." Então eles viverão na sua própria terra.
pt.R: Em vez disso, vão dizer: "Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus que trouxe os descendentes de Israel da terra do norte e de todos os países para onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os tinha espalhado." Então eles vão viver na sua própria terra.

decisions.choice: differences from 16:15
decisions.reason: Where 16:15 has one verb, "brought up", this verse has two, "brought up and led"; where 16:15 has "the {children} of Israel", this verse has "the offspring of the house of Israel"; where 16:15 has "he had driven them", this verse has "I had driven them"; and where 16:15 ends "I will bring them back to their land that I gave to their fathers", this verse ends "they will dwell on their own land".

decisions.choice: where I had driven them: God's own voice breaks into the oath
decisions.reason: Inside the words people will say, the Hebrew has "I had driven them", as if God himself finished the sentence; 16:15 has "he" here. The meaning is the same: God both sent them away and brings them back.

decisions.choice: the land of the north: Babylon, the land of exile
decisions.reason: Invaders came on Judah from the north (1:14; 4:6; 6:22), since the road from Babylon ran round by the north, and the exiles were taken away by the same road.

decisions.choice: where he had scattered them
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the speakers' own voice in the oath, as 16:15 has it, so that the reader is not confused by a sudden "I" in the people's words. Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew's "I". "Scattered" is Readable's plainer word for "driven", as in 16:15.

decisions.choice: Instead they will say; the God who led
decisions.reason: As in 16:15: Readable ends verse 7 with a full sentence, so it repeats the verb here, and it says "the God who led" so that the oath clearly names the LORD by what he did.

decisions.choice: "내가 그들을 쫓아냈던" inside the oath
decisions.reason: God's own voice breaks into the people's oath (meaning decision m2), and Literal and Balanced keep "내가"; Readable smooths it to "그분이 ... 흩으셨던", as the English Readable does.

source.text: לַנְּבִאִ֞ים נִשְׁבַּ֧ר לִבִּ֣י בְקִרְבִּ֗י רָֽחֲפוּ֙ כָּל־עַצְמוֹתַ֔י הָיִ֨יתִי֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ שִׁכּ֔וֹרוּכְגֶ֖בֶר עֲבָ֣רוֹ יָ֑יִן מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמִפְּנֵ֖י דִּבְרֵ֥י קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Concerning the prophets: is broken my heart in my midst, tremble all my bones; I have become like a man drunk and like a man [whom] has passed over him wine, because of Yahweh and because of [the] words of his holiness.

en.L: Concerning the prophets: \q My heart is broken inside me; all my bones shake; \q I have become like a drunken man, \q like a man whom wine has overcome, \q because of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and because of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy words.
en.B: Concerning the prophets: \q My heart is crushed inside me, and all my bones are shaking. \q I am like a drunk man, \q like someone overpowered by wine, \q because of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and because of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy words.
en.R: About the prophets: \q My heart is broken, and my whole body shakes. \q I am like a man who is drunk, \q who has had too much wine, \q because of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy words.

es.L: Acerca de los profetas: \q Mi corazón está quebrantado dentro de mí; tiemblan todos mis huesos; \q estoy como un hombre ebrio, \q como un hombre a quien domina el vino, \q a causa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y a causa de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santas palabras.
es.B: Acerca de los profetas: \q Tengo el corazón destrozado dentro de mí, y todos mis huesos tiemblan. \q Estoy como un borracho, \q como alguien a quien ha vencido el vino, \q a causa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santas palabras.
es.R: Acerca de los profetas: \q Tengo el corazón destrozado, y todo mi cuerpo tiembla. \q Estoy como un hombre borracho, \q que ha bebido demasiado vino, \q por causa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santas palabras.

fr.L: Au sujet des prophètes : \q Mon cœur est brisé au-dedans de moi, tous mes os tremblent ; \q je suis devenu comme un homme ivre, \q comme un homme que le vin a vaincu, \q à cause {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saintes paroles.
fr.B: Au sujet des prophètes : \q Mon cœur est brisé en moi, et tous mes os tremblent. \q Je suis comme un homme ivre, \q comme quelqu’un que le vin a terrassé, \q à cause {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saintes paroles.
fr.R: Au sujet des prophètes : \q J’ai le cœur brisé, et tout mon corps tremble. \q Je suis comme un homme qui a bu, \q qui a pris trop de vin, \q à cause {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saintes paroles.

sw.L: Kuhusu manabii: \q Moyo wangu umevunjika ndani yangu; mifupa yangu yote inatetemeka; \q nimekuwa kama mtu aliyelewa, \q kama mtu aliyeshindwa na divai, \q kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kwa sababu ya maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} matakatifu.
sw.B: Kuhusu manabii: \q Moyo wangu umepondeka ndani yangu, na mifupa yangu yote inatetemeka. \q Niko kama mtu mlevi, \q kama mtu aliyezidiwa na divai, \q kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kwa sababu ya maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} matakatifu.
sw.R: Kuhusu manabii: \q Moyo wangu umevunjika, na mwili wangu wote unatetemeka. \q Niko kama mtu aliyelewa, \q aliyekunywa divai kupita kiasi, \q kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} matakatifu.

vi.L: Về các nhà tiên tri: \q Lòng tôi tan nát trong tôi; mọi xương cốt tôi run rẩy; \q tôi như người say rượu, \q như người bị rượu chế ngự, \q vì cớ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và vì cớ những lời thánh của Ngài.
vi.B: Về các nhà tiên tri: \q Lòng tôi tan nát trong tôi, mọi xương cốt tôi run rẩy. \q Tôi như một người say, \q như kẻ bị rượu làm cho choáng váng, \q vì cớ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và vì những lời thánh của Ngài.
vi.R: Về các nhà tiên tri: \q Lòng tôi tan nát, và toàn thân tôi run rẩy. \q Tôi giống như một người say rượu, \q một người đã uống quá nhiều rượu, \q vì cớ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và những lời thánh của Ngài.

ko.L: 예언자들에 대하여. \q 내 속에서 내 마음이 부서지고, 내 모든 뼈가 떨린다. \q 내가 취한 사람 같고, \q 포도주에 사로잡힌 사람 같다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 때문이며, 그분의 거룩한 말씀 때문이다.
ko.B: 예언자들에 대한 말씀이다. \q 내 마음이 속에서 무너지고, 내 모든 뼈가 떨린다. \q 내가 술 취한 사람 같고, \q 포도주에 못 이겨 비틀거리는 사람 같다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 때문이며, 그분의 거룩한 말씀 때문이다.
ko.R: 예언자들에 대한 말씀이다. \q 내 마음은 찢어지고, 온몸이 떨린다. \q 나는 술 취한 사람 같다. \q 포도주를 너무 많이 마신 사람 같다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 그분의 거룩한 말씀 때문이다.

pt.L: A respeito dos profetas: \q O meu coração está quebrado dentro de mim; todos os meus ossos tremem; \q fiquei como um homem embriagado, \q como um homem a quem o vinho dominou, \q por causa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e por causa das {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} santas palavras.
pt.B: A respeito dos profetas: \q O meu coração está esmagado dentro de mim, e todos os meus ossos estremecem. \q Estou como um homem bêbado, \q como alguém dominado pelo vinho, \q por causa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e por causa das {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} santas palavras.
pt.R: Sobre os profetas: \q O meu coração está despedaçado, e o meu corpo inteiro treme. \q Estou como um homem bêbado, \q que bebeu vinho demais, \q por causa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e das {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} santas palavras.

decisions.choice: Concerning the prophets: the title of verses 9-40
decisions.reason: The words stand as a heading for the long collection that follows, as "To the house of the king of Judah" heads 21:11-22:30 and as the names of nations head the oracles of chapters 46-49.

decisions.choice: my heart, my bones: Jeremiah speaks
decisions.reason: The speaker names the LORD as "the LORD" and is shaken by his words, so these are the prophet's own words, as in 4:19 and 8:18. From verse 11 God speaks.

decisions.choice: shake: go weak and tremble
decisions.reason: The verb is rare. Elsewhere it is used of a bird hovering over its young (Deuteronomy 32:11) and of the Spirit over the waters (Genesis 1:2). Here it seems to mean that the prophet's body trembles and loses its strength.

decisions.choice: like a drunken man: overwhelmed and unsteady
decisions.reason: The prophet is not drunk; he staggers like a drunk man because God's holy words have overcome him. What he must say about the prophets has shaken him to the core.

decisions.choice: my whole body shakes
decisions.reason: Readable says "my whole body" for "all my bones", the Hebrew way of speaking of the whole person.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah speaks as "tôi" here
decisions.reason: In verses 9-10 Jeremiah speaks about God, not to him, so he uses the plain "tôi" of the prophet speaking to the people (terms note), not the "con" of his prayers.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah speaks in the plain style with "나", and of God with the honorific ("그분의")
decisions.reason: Here the prophet speaks about God, not to him (meaning decision m2), so it is not set as a prayer.

decisions.choice: os profetas
decisions.reason: The heading says only "the prophets" (m1), and so does the Portuguese, as the English does; "falsos profetas" is kept for the places where the English says so.

source.text: כִּ֤י מְנָֽאֲפִים֙ מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּֽי־מִפְּנֵ֤י אָלָה֙ אָבְלָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ יָבְשׁ֖וּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וַתְּהִ֤י מְרֽוּצָתָם֙ רָעָ֔ה וּגְבוּרָתָ֖ם לֹא־כֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: For [with] adulterers is full the land; for because of a curse mourns the land, are dried up [the] pastures of [the] wilderness; and is their course evil, and their might [is] not right.

en.L: For the land is full of adulterers; \q for because of a curse the land mourns; \q the pastures of the wilderness have dried up. \q And their course has become evil, \q and their strength [is] not right.
en.B: The land is full of adulterers. \q The land mourns under the curse, \q and the wilderness pastures have withered. \q They run their race toward evil, \q and they use their power for what is wrong.
en.R: The land is full of people who are unfaithful in marriage. \q Because of the curse, the land is dry and dying, \q and the grass in the open country has dried up. \q The people rush to do evil, \q and they use their power in the wrong way.

es.L: Porque la tierra está llena de adúlteros; \q porque a causa de la maldición la tierra está de luto; \q se han secado los pastos del desierto. \q Y su carrera es mala, \q y su fuerza no [es] recta.
es.B: La tierra está llena de adúlteros. \q La tierra está de luto bajo la maldición, \q y los pastos del desierto se han secado. \q Corren tras el mal, \q y usan su poder para lo injusto.
es.R: La tierra está llena de gente que es infiel en el matrimonio. \q Por la maldición, la tierra está seca y muriéndose, \q y la hierba del campo se ha secado. \q La gente corre a hacer el mal, \q y usa su poder de mala manera.

fr.L: Car le pays est plein d’adultères ; \q car à cause de la malédiction le pays est en deuil ; \q les pâturages du désert sont desséchés. \q Leur course est devenue mauvaise, \q et leur force n’[est] pas droite.
fr.B: Le pays est rempli d’adultères. \q Le pays est en deuil sous la malédiction, \q et les pâturages du désert se sont desséchés. \q Ils courent vers le mal, \q et ils emploient leur force à ce qui est injuste.
fr.R: Le pays est plein de gens qui trompent leur conjoint. \q À cause de la malédiction, le pays est sec et se meurt, \q et l’herbe de la campagne a séché. \q Les gens se précipitent pour faire le mal, \q et ils se servent de leur pouvoir pour faire ce qui est mal.

sw.L: Kwa maana nchi imejaa wazinzi; \q kwa maana kwa sababu ya laana nchi inaomboleza; \q malisho ya nyikani yamekauka. \q Na mwendo wao umekuwa mbaya, \q na nguvu zao [si] za haki.
sw.B: Nchi imejaa wazinzi. \q Nchi inaomboleza chini ya laana, \q na malisho ya nyikani yamenyauka. \q Wanakimbilia uovu, \q nao wanatumia nguvu zao kwa yasiyo ya haki.
sw.R: Nchi imejaa watu wasio waaminifu katika ndoa. \q Kwa sababu ya laana, nchi imekauka na inakufa, \q na majani ya porini yamekauka. \q Watu wanakimbilia kutenda maovu, \q nao wanatumia nguvu zao vibaya.

vi.L: Vì xứ đầy những kẻ ngoại tình; \q vì cớ sự rủa sả, đất than khóc; \q các đồng cỏ nơi hoang mạc đều khô héo. \q Đường lối chúng đã thành gian ác, \q và sức mạnh chúng [là] không chính đáng.
vi.B: Xứ đầy dẫy những kẻ ngoại tình. \q Đất than khóc dưới sự rủa sả, \q các đồng cỏ nơi hoang mạc đều héo khô. \q Chúng chạy theo điều ác, \q và dùng quyền lực mình vào điều sai trái.
vi.R: Xứ đầy những người không chung thủy trong hôn nhân. \q Vì sự rủa sả, đất đai khô cằn và tàn úa, \q cỏ ngoài đồng trống đều khô héo. \q Dân chúng vội vàng làm điều ác, \q và dùng quyền lực mình một cách sai trái.

ko.L: 땅이 간음하는 자들로 가득하다. \q 저주 때문에 땅이 슬퍼하고, \q 광야의 목초지들이 말라 버렸다. \q 그들의 달음질은 악하고, \q 그들의 힘은 옳지 않다.
ko.B: 이 땅은 간음하는 자들로 가득하다. \q 저주 때문에 땅이 슬퍼하고, \q 광야의 풀밭이 말라 버렸다. \q 그들은 악을 향하여 달려가고, \q 그들의 힘을 그릇되게 쓴다.
ko.R: 이 땅은 결혼 생활에서 신의를 저버린 사람들로 가득하다. \q 저주 때문에 땅은 메말라 죽어 가고, \q 들판의 풀도 말라 버렸다. \q 사람들은 악한 일을 하려고 서둘러 달려가고, \q 그들의 힘을 그릇된 일에 쓴다.

pt.L: Pois de adúlteros está cheia a terra; \q pois por causa de uma maldição a terra está de luto, \q secaram as pastagens do deserto. \q E a sua carreira se tornou má, \q e a sua força não [é] reta.
pt.B: A terra está cheia de adúlteros. \q A terra está de luto sob a maldição, \q e as pastagens do deserto murcharam. \q Eles correm a sua corrida em direção ao mal \q e usam o seu poder para o que é errado.
pt.R: A terra está cheia de gente que trai o próprio casamento. \q Por causa da maldição, a terra está seca e morrendo, \q e o capim nos campos abertos secou. \q As pessoas correm para fazer o mal \q e usam o seu poder do jeito errado.

decisions.choice: adulterers: unfaithful to their marriages and to God
decisions.reason: Jeremiah charges the people with adultery in the plain sense (5:7-8; 7:9; 29:23), and he also calls their worship of other gods adultery (3:8-9). Verse 14 says the prophets themselves do it.

decisions.choice: a curse: the curse of the covenant
decisions.reason: The covenant warned that if the people broke it, the sky would hold back rain and the land would fail (11:3-8; Deuteronomy 28:15, 23-24). The drought is the curse coming true (14:1-6).

decisions.choice: mourns: dries up and withers
decisions.reason: The verb means to mourn, and when used of the land, to dry up (12:4; Amos 1:2). Both pictures are here: the land grieves, and the land withers.

decisions.choice: their course ... their strength: the way they live and the power they use
decisions.reason: "Course" is the running of a race (8:6). "Their" may mean the people of the land or the prophets and priests of verse 11; they run hard after evil and use their strength for wrong.

decisions.choice: dry and dying
decisions.reason: Readable puts the two senses of the verb (m3) into plain words.

source.text: כִּֽי־גַם־נָבִ֥יא גַם־כֹּהֵ֖ן חָנֵ֑פוּ גַּם־בְּבֵיתִ֛י מָצָ֥אתִי רָעָתָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For both prophet and priest are polluted; even in my house I have found their evil, declares Yahweh.

en.L: For both prophet and priest are polluted; \q even in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house I have found their evil, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: For both prophet and priest are godless; \q even in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own house I have found their wickedness, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Both the prophets and the priests have turned away from God. \q I have found them doing evil even in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own house, the temple, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Porque tanto el profeta como el sacerdote están contaminados; \q aun en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa he hallado su maldad, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Porque tanto el profeta como el sacerdote son impíos; \q aun en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} propia casa he encontrado su maldad, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Tanto los profetas como los sacerdotes se han apartado de Dios. \q Los he encontrado haciendo el mal aun en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} propia casa, el templo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Car prophète et prêtre sont profanes ; \q même dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison j’ai trouvé leur méchanceté, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Car prophète et prêtre sont sans Dieu ; \q jusque dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison j’ai trouvé leur méchanceté, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les prophètes et les prêtres se sont détournés de Dieu. \q Je les ai trouvés en train de faire le mal jusque dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} propre maison, le temple, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana nabii na kuhani pia wamenajisika; \q hata katika nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} nimeuona uovu wao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana nabii na kuhani pia hawamchi Mungu; \q hata katika nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} mwenyewe nimeuona uovu wao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Manabii na makuhani wote wamemwacha Mungu. \q Nimewaona wakitenda maovu hata katika nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} mwenyewe, yaani hekalu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vì cả nhà tiên tri lẫn thầy tế lễ đều ô uế; \q ngay trong nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng đã thấy điều ác của chúng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Vì cả nhà tiên tri lẫn thầy tế lễ đều vô đạo; \q ngay trong chính nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng đã thấy sự gian ác của chúng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Cả các nhà tiên tri lẫn các thầy tế lễ đều đã lìa bỏ Đức Chúa Trời. \q Ta đã thấy chúng làm điều ác ngay trong nhà của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là đền thờ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 예언자도 제사장도 더러워졌다. \q 내 집에서도 내가 그들의 악을 보았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 예언자도 제사장도 모두 경건하지 않다. \q 내 집에서조차 내가 그들의 악행을 보았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 예언자들도 제사장들도 하나님에게서 떠났다. \q 내 집인 성전에서조차 나는 그들이 악한 일을 하는 것을 보았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Pois tanto o profeta como o sacerdote estão contaminados; \q até na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa encontrei a maldade deles, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Pois tanto o profeta como o sacerdote são ímpios; \q até na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} própria casa encontrei a maldade deles, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Tanto os profetas como os sacerdotes se afastaram de Deus. \q Eu os encontrei fazendo o mal até na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} própria casa, o templo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: polluted: godless, unclean before God
decisions.reason: The verb is used of land made unclean by bloodshed and sin (3:1-2, 9; Numbers 35:33), and of people who have turned from God (Isaiah 24:5). The leaders of worship have become profane.

decisions.choice: my house: the temple in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: God calls the temple his house. Wrong was done even there: idols and false worship (7:10-11, 30; 32:34).

decisions.choice: the temple
decisions.reason: Readable says what "my house" means.

source.text: לָכֵן֩ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה דַרְכָּ֜ם לָהֶ֗ם כַּחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת֙ בָּֽאֲפֵלָ֔ה יִדַּ֖חוּ וְנָ֣פְלוּ בָ֑הּ כִּֽי־אָבִ֨יא עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם רָעָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore will be their way to them like slippery places in the darkness; they will be pushed and fall in it; for I will bring on them disaster, [the] year of their punishment, declares Yahweh.

en.L: Therefore their way will be to them like slippery places in the darkness; \q they will be thrust down and fall in it; \q for I will bring disaster on them, the year of their punishment, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: So their path will become like slippery ground in the dark; \q they will be pushed down, and there they will fall. \q For I will bring disaster on them in the year I punish them, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: So the road they walk on will be slippery and dark. \q They will be pushed, and they will fall. \q I will bring disaster on them when it is time for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to punish them, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Por tanto, su camino será para ellos como lugares resbaladizos en la oscuridad; \q serán empujados y caerán en él; \q porque traeré sobre ellos el mal, el año de su castigo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Por eso su sendero será como un suelo resbaladizo en la oscuridad; \q los empujarán y allí caerán. \q Porque traeré sobre ellos la desgracia el año en que los castigue, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Por eso, el camino por donde andan será resbaladizo y oscuro. \q Los empujarán, y caerán. \q Traeré desgracia sobre ellos cuando llegue el tiempo de castigarlos, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi leur chemin sera pour eux comme des lieux glissants dans les ténèbres ; \q ils seront poussés et y tomberont ; \q car je ferai venir sur eux le malheur, l’année de leur châtiment, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Aussi leur chemin deviendra comme un sol glissant dans l’obscurité ; \q ils seront poussés et ils y tomberont. \q Car je ferai venir le malheur sur eux l’année où je les punirai, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors la route sur laquelle ils marchent deviendra glissante et sombre. \q On les poussera, et ils tomberont. \q Je ferai venir le malheur sur eux quand le moment sera venu pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} de les punir, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo njia yao itakuwa kwao kama mahali penye utelezi gizani; \q watasukumwa na kuanguka ndani yake; \q kwa maana nitaleta maafa juu yao, mwaka wa kuadhibiwa kwao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo njia yao itakuwa kama ardhi yenye utelezi gizani; \q watasukumwa chini, nao wataanguka huko. \q Kwa maana nitaleta maafa juu yao katika mwaka nitakaowaadhibu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo njia wanayoitembea itakuwa na utelezi na giza. \q Watasukumwa, nao wataanguka. \q Nitaleta maafa juu yao wakati utakapofika wa kuwaadhibu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vì vậy đường lối chúng sẽ như những chỗ trơn trợt trong bóng tối; \q chúng sẽ bị xô đẩy và ngã trên đó; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giáng tai họa trên chúng, là năm chúng bị trừng phạt, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Vì vậy, con đường chúng đi sẽ như đất trơn trợt trong bóng tối; \q chúng sẽ bị xô ngã và ngã quỵ trên đó. \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giáng tai họa trên chúng trong năm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trừng phạt chúng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Vì vậy, con đường chúng đi sẽ trơn trợt và tối tăm. \q Chúng sẽ bị xô đẩy và ngã nhào. \q Ta sẽ giáng tai họa trên chúng khi đến lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trừng phạt chúng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
